    // 1. Hunt for the player's Lastname from "(XXX residence)"
    let Lastname = "Surname"; // Fallback default just in case the player left it blank
    const residenceRegex = /You live alone in an apartment complex not far from the school \((.+?)\s+residence\)/i;
    
    // Check Story Cards first (both Entry and Description/Notes)
    for (let i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      let card = storyCards[i];
      let matchEntry = card.entry && card.entry.match(residenceRegex);
      let matchDesc = card.description && card.description.match(residenceRegex);
      let nameMatch = matchEntry || matchDesc;
      
      if (nameMatch && nameMatch[1].trim() !== "") {
        Lastname = nameMatch[1].trim();
        break; // Stop hunting once we find it
      }
    }
    
    // Optional Backup: Also check Plot Essentials (state.memory.context) & current text just in case
    if (Lastname === "Surname") {
      let contextMatch = state.memory && state.memory.context && state.memory.context.match(residenceRegex);
      let textMatch = typeof text === "string" && text.match(residenceRegex);
      let backupMatch = contextMatch || textMatch;
      if (backupMatch && backupMatch[1].trim() !== "") {
        Lastname = backupMatch[1].trim();
      }
    }

    // Save to state in case you ever need the player's last name in future turns
    state.playerLastname = Lastname;

    // 2. Define the intros and replace ${Lastname} with what we caught
    const intros = [
"\"Hey, ${Lastname}-sensei! Kurose-sensei asked me to bring these over!\" A cheerful voice cuts through the faculty room chaos. Your junior colleague from the same department, Mochizuki Shiori, bounds up to your desk, her short brown hair and signature ahoge bouncing energetically. Miraculously, she hasn't tripped once on her way over. She beams proudly, holding out a crisp folder. \"Here's your first-year class roster! Don't forget our lesson planning after lunch!\"",
"\"Good morning, ${Lastname}-sensei! Ready for the new term?\" Your fellow department teacher, Mochizuki Shiori, pops up beside your desk with a bright, adorable grin. For once, the notorious airhead actually looks somewhat prepared for the day ahead. She excitedly places a freshly printed stack of papers right next to your coffee mug, her ahoge bobbing as she nods. \"I grabbed your first-year class roster from the printer for you! Let's do our best today!\"",
"\"H-help me, ${Lastname}-sensei! Watch out!\" A panicked shriek echoes as your clumsy department junior, Mochizuki Shiori, catches her foot on a completely flat patch of carpet. She pitches forward, sending a massive blizzard of paper flying into the air before crashing into your desk. Rubbing her bruised nose, her short brown hair and ahoge frazzled, she looks up with watery eyes. \"I-I'm so sorry! The printer jammed and... well, your first-year class roster is in this pile somewhere!\"",
"\"${Lastname}-sensei, save me! I'm totally doomed!\" Mochizuki Shiori, your scatterbrained fellow teacher in charge of the second-years, practically sprints to your side in a dizzying panic. Her adorable face is pale as she frantically shakes a horribly shuffled, upside-down stack of documents at you. \"I dropped the freshly printed sheets in the hallway and now my rosters are completely mixed up with your first-year class roster! Please help me sort them before Kanda comes back!\"",
"\"There you are, ${Lastname}-sensei. Still alive, I see.\" A weary voice sighs behind you. You turn to see your department head, Kurose Ryohei, looking as lanky and exhausted as ever with his messy black hair and dark, tired eyes. He casually tosses a folder onto your desk, rubbing the back of his neck. \"Managed to grab your first-year class roster before the copier exploded on me. Good luck at the ceremony. Don't forget we have lesson planning this afternoon.\"",
"A heavy, desensitized sigh sounds beside your desk. Your department head, Kurose Ryohei, stands there blinking his tired eyes, a stray crow feather somehow tangled in his messy black hair. \"Morning, ${Lastname}-sensei. Somehow survived the commute,\" he mutters deadpan, brushing the feather away before sliding a crisp clipboard across your desk. \"Here's the first-year class roster for your homeroom. Let's just survive Kanda's speech and make it to lunch, yeah?\"",
"A sudden, loud crash from the copy corner makes the staff jump. You look over to see your perpetually cursed department head, Kurose Ryohei, buried beneath a collapsed shelf and a mountain of paper. He pokes his messy black head out from the wreckage, his tired eyes completely numb to his atrocious luck. \"Hey, ${Lastname}-sensei... give me a hand?\" he calls out flatly. \"A stray cat jumped through the window and knocked the rack over. Your first-year class roster is buried under me.\"",
"\"${Lastname}-sensei, got a towel? Or maybe an exorcist?\" Your lanky department head, Kurose Ryohei, shuffles hurriedly toward your desk, holding a dripping wet stack of papers at arm's length. His messy black hair is plastered to his forehead, his tired eyes radiating pure, defeated exhaustion. \"Pipe burst in the hallway right above my head. It soaked the master copies, so I need you to help me reprint your first-year class roster before the ceremony starts.\""
    ].map(intro => intro.replace(/\$\{Lastname\}/g, Lastname));

  // --- CALENDAR LOGIC & CARD CREATION ---
  if (state.triggerCalendarUpdate) {
    const dayNum = state.currentDay;
    
    // 1. Calculate Exact Date and Month
    const months = [
      { name: "April", days: 30 }, { name: "May", days: 31 }, { name: "June", days: 30 },
      { name: "July", days: 31 }, { name: "August", days: 31 }, { name: "September", days: 30 },
      { name: "October", days: 31 }, { name: "November", days: 30 }, { name: "December", days: 31 },
      { name: "January", days: 31 }, { name: "February", days: 28 }, { name: "March", days: 31 }
    ];
    
    let remaining = dayNum;
    let currentMonth = "";
    let currentDate = 1;
    
    for (let m of months) {
      if (remaining <= m.days) {
        currentMonth = m.name;
        currentDate = remaining;
        break;
      }
      remaining -= m.days;
    }

    const daysOfWeek = ["Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"];
    const dow = daysOfWeek[(dayNum - 1) % 7]; 

    // 2. Determine Current Term
    let currentTerm = 1;
    if (dayNum >= 285) {
      currentTerm = 3; 
    } else if (dayNum >= 154) {
      currentTerm = 2; 
    } else if (dayNum >= 11) {
      currentTerm = 1; 
    }

    // 3. Check Events and School Status
    let isSchoolClosed = (dow === "Sunday"); 
    let activeEvents = [];
    let upcomingEvents = [];

    events.forEach(e => {
      if (dayNum >= e.startDay && dayNum <= e.endDay) {
        activeEvents.push(e);
        if (e.closed) isSchoolClosed = true;
      } else if (e.startDay > dayNum) {
        let diff = e.startDay - dayNum;
        if (diff <= e.notice) {
          // Check if this is the very first day the notification pops up
          let isAnnouncement = (diff === e.notice && e.notify);
          upcomingEvents.push({ name: e.name, diff: diff, announce: isAnnouncement });
        }
      }
    });

    // CHECK FOR SPECIFIC MAJOR BREAKS
    let isMajorBreak = activeEvents.some(e => 
      ["Spring Break", "Summer Break", "Winter Break"].includes(e.name)
    );

    // CHECK FOR HOLIDAYS THAT OVERRIDE BREAKS (Any closed event that ISN'T the break itself)
    let isHolidayOverride = activeEvents.some(e => 
      e.closed && !["Spring Break", "Summer Break", "Winter Break"].includes(e.name)
    );

    // 4. Construct the Calendar Text
    let calText = `Current Date: ${dow}, ${currentMonth} ${currentDate}\n`;
    
  // DETERMINE TODAY'S SUBJECTS
    let todaySubjects = "";
    if (isHolidayOverride) {
      todaySubjects = "None"; // Special holidays override the break schedule
    } else if (isMajorBreak) {
      todaySubjects = schedules["Break"][dow]; // Teacher working schedule for major breaks
    } else if (isSchoolClosed) {
      todaySubjects = "None"; // Standard Sundays
    } else {
      todaySubjects = schedules[currentTerm][dow]; // Normal school day
    }
    
    calText += `Today's Periods: ${todaySubjects}\n`;

    // Append active events
    activeEvents.forEach(e => {
      if (e.startDay === e.endDay) {
        calText += `${e.name} today\n`;
      } else {
        let daysLeft = e.endDay - dayNum;
        let status = daysLeft > 0 ? `ongoing for ${daysLeft} more days` : `ending today`;
        calText += `${e.name} ${status}\n`;
      }
    });

    // Append countdowns
    upcomingEvents.forEach(e => {
      let prefix = e.announce ? "Announcement: " : "";
      let timeStr = e.diff === 1 ? "tomorrow" : `in ${e.diff} days`;
      calText += `${prefix}${e.name} ${timeStr}\n`;
    });

    // Format text with ## prefix on every line
    let formattedText = calText.trim().split('\n').map(line => `## ${line}`).join('\n');

// 5. Purge old Calendar, Curriculum, and Character cards to prevent clutter
    for (let i = storyCards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const title = storyCards[i].title;
      if (
        title === "🗓️ Calendar" || title === "Calendar"
      ) {
        storyCards.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // 6. Inject Fresh Cards into Memory
    // Inject Calendar (Index 0)
    constructCard({
      type: "Calendar",
      title: "🗓️ Calendar",
      keys: "You,?,.,!",
      entry: formattedText,
      description: `In case you forget, there are a few things to keep in mind:
🌙 Progress: Ready for the next day? Just type 'pass the day' or 'end the day' when you're at home or not in the middle of a conversation/scene!
⏩ Secret Time Skip Easter Egg: Type 'go into autopilot' to skip forward 3 days. Warning: Do not use during the first week (before April 18). Use at your own risk.
🗓️ Calendar: Check your Calendar in Story Cards regularly! It automatically updates everyday with school curriculum, upcoming events, and more!
‼️ Important: Please, absolutely make sure Optimized Context is disabled! You can find it in Gameplay settings (if it doesn't appear, it's OK)!`
    }, 0); 

    delete state.triggerCalendarUpdate;
  }

  return { text };
};

// Constructs a new story card from a standardized template object
function constructCard(templateCard, insertionIndex = 0) {
  addStoryCard("%@%");
  for (const [index, card] of storyCards.entries()) {
    if (card.title !== "%@%") continue;
    
    card.type = templateCard.type;
    card.title = templateCard.title;
    card.keys = templateCard.keys;
    card.entry = templateCard.entry;
    card.description = templateCard.description;
    
    if (index !== insertionIndex) {
      storyCards.splice(index, 1);
      storyCards.splice(insertionIndex, 0, card);
    }
    return Object.seal(card);
  }
  return {}; 
}
